items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, and those people. Because he had to have some place to take off from there, but a whole lot of white musicians, you know, you wouldn’t have had a Stan Getz without a Coleman Hawkins, would you?

You wouldn’t have an Earl Bostic without Coleman Hawkins. So all of that music belongs together and I’ll just repeat what I said earlier that I think it’s easier and even that’s not easy to separate southern music or northern music with an area like rhythm & blues where things do tend to kind of overlap. But I think the north-south distinction is a more useful one that the black and white one. And that’s true of the blues too because if you’re talking about white blues singers, what about Jack Teagarden, what…
